## Welcome

This is the first post on my new blog. I'm planning to use this space to share thoughts, ideas, and things I'm learning.

I built this site with [Quarto](https://quarto.org), which makes it easy to write content in Markdown and publish to the web. The aesthetic is intentionally minimal - I prefer focusing on content over flashy design.

More to come soon.
